title: I’m working on writing a book about the way all of this has unfolded through my life, how it led me to create this community, and where I think it might be heading… what would you all think about collectively being my editors and co-authors?
content: I’m thinking I can drop paragraphs or chapters in here as I go and get feedback and suggestions from anyone who has something to add, or might have a piece of the puzzle that I’m missing or overlooking. I was considering doing a podcast or something like that for a while but I think a book is probably a more appropriate medium for the subject.
